title: Multiobjective Personalization of Marketing Interventions
authors: Omid Rafieian; Anuj Kapoor; Amitt Sharma
eligible_reason: Multiobjective personalization algorithms applied to a randomized video-ad experiment (skippable/long vs non-skippable/short formats) with CATE estimation and policy evaluation. Session-level cross-sectional randomization, no DiD.
design_notes: MKSC-Vdo.R: CATE models for ad consumption and video consumption, inverse-propensity policy evaluation on train/test split of sessions.
data_files_note: ReadMe.txt: 'The present data closely resemble the one used in the paper. However, for privacy reasons, some variables are dropped.'
data_provenance_note: Session-level experiment data with some variables dropped; 'closely resemble' wording leaves open whether values are altered.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
